articles.title: Crypto political group details list of U.S. congressional allies its backing this year
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto, a member group that rates the crypto friendliness of politicians, is supporting 32 U.S. House incumbents, with more endorsements coming.

articles.title: Coinbase debuts tokenized stocks on Base network, joining race to bring equities on blockchain
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange is starting with tokenized versions of Apple, Nvidia, Meta and Alphabet, issued under its new Abu Dhabi framework.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine buys $81 million of ETH in largest weekly haul since early July
articles.snippet: The treasury firm stepped up its ETH buying as Tom Lee said the crypto’s 30% weekly rally could signal a larger move ahead.

articles.title: New Solana vote could ramp daily SOL burns to $800,000 and slow new token creation
articles.snippet: Two of the three proposals would reduce SOL supply growth by speeding up Solana’s inflation decline and raising daily fee burns from about 650 SOL to as much as 9,000 SOL.

articles.title: Strategy raises $2 billion through MSTR sales and creates new USD Cash pool
articles.snippet: The company sold 18.26 million MSTR shares, increased its USD Reserve to $5.1 billion and repurchased another $136.4 million of STRC.
